title: Soil physico-chemical properties from eight UK agricultural sites, 2022
attribution: Contains data supplied by UK Centre for Ecology & Hydrology.
citation: Keith, A.M.; Appleton, E.R.; Pritchard, L.; Eves, N.; Tandy, S.; Brentegani, M.; Norris, D. (2024). Soil physico-chemical properties from eight UK agricultural sites, 2022. NERC EDS Environmental Information Data Centre. https://doi.org/10.5285/8c87a397-a010-48a4-8ca5-0f3742c2d857
measurement_status: laboratory-measured soil properties; not modelled thermal resistivity
crs: EPSG:4326 (catalogue); individual sample geometry not inspected
units: Pending inspection of CSV and supporting methods; no numeric conversion authorised by metadata alone.
limitations: Moisture, texture and density are contextual soil properties, not cable-design thermal resistivity measurements. No electrical-to-thermal resistivity conversion. Requires site thermal testing and engineering assessment.
import_blocker: Combined archive exceeded the 10 MB probe cap because supporting DOCX files are large. Numeric CSV entries were identified in official RO-Crate metadata but not retrieved or validated. No synthetic numeric output is supplied.
